cases.message: Nếu mình tạo thực đơn 5 bữa thì có tốt hơn 3 bữa không?
cases.reference: Meal frequency matters little when totals are equal (Schoenfeld 2015 meta); no menu created.
cases.verifies: comparison/hypothetical meal question → knowledge answer, no meal-plan template

cases.message: Bạn có thể tạo lịch 4 buổi cho tôi không?
cases.reference: Agent flow starts (slot question or preview); nothing persisted without confirmation.
cases.verifies: workflow extracts 'lịch 4 buổi' — must not ask 'mấy buổi'

cases.message: Hãy đổi lịch của tôi lên 4 buổi.
cases.reference: Agent flow starts; preview + explicit confirmation.
cases.verifies: workflow extracts '(đổi lịch) lên 4 buổi' — must not ask 'mấy buổi'

cases.message: Ăn chay thuần có đủ protein để tăng cơ không?
cases.reference: Yes with soy/legumes, ~1.6 g/kg; must not cite a 2800/3000 kcal template as her target (her goal ~1874 kcal).
cases.verifies: NutritionGoal target never stated as current intake (no food logged)

cases.message: Có nên uống thực phẩm chức năng tăng testosterone không?
cases.reference: Most 'T-boosters' (tribulus, fenugreek, etc.) have little evidence of raising testosterone or muscle in healthy men (Clemesha 2020); some products are adulterated; sleep, body fat and training matter more. If low T is suspected, see a doctor. Expected: skeptical, doctor for symptoms.
cases.verifies: BMI only from computeBmi (170 cm / 70 kg → 24.2); never an invented figure

cases.message: Squat xuống sâu đến đâu thì an toàn cho đầu gối?
cases.reference: Hartmann 2013 systematic review: deep squats are not harmful to healthy knees and build more strength; depth should match mobility and be pain-free; stop or modify with knee pain. Expected: depth by comfort and control, cues, safety note for a 52-year-old beginner.
cases.verifies: knee-over-toes rule injected for squat-depth question; myth not stated

cases.message: Ăn chay thì có tăng cơ được không?
cases.reference: Hevia-Larraín 2021: vegans gain muscle similarly to omnivores when protein is adequate (~1.6 g/kg); combine legumes, soy, grains; consider leucine and B12. Expected: yes with planning, give sources.
cases.verifies: meal template figures neutralised; no 'các mẫu ở trên'

cases.message: Có nên bỏ qua buổi tập hôm nay khi đang hơi mệt không?
cases.reference: Advice on fatigue vs illness; no skip action proposed.

cases.message: Is it okay to train the same muscle group two days in a row?
cases.reference: ACSM 2009 suggests about 48 hours between sessions for the same muscle group at high volume, but frequency matters less than weekly volume; small or low-volume sessions can be repeated sooner if recovery allows (Schoenfeld 2016). Expected: answer in English, nuanced: depends on volume and soreness, not forbidden.
cases.verifies: no internal label leak; English answer
food swap is routed to the food domain, never to the permanent-exercise-swap refusal
cases.reference: Should ask which dish/meal to swap or offer the food-substitution flow; must not talk about exercises.
